title: Japanese Lamb Biryani
description: A unique fusion of Japanese and Indian flavors in a delicious lamb biryani dish. The warmth of roasted spices pairs perfectly with the savory taste of lamb.

ingredients.name: Lamb
ingredients.notes: Boneless lamb shoulder or neck fillet

ingredients.name: Warmly roasted cumin
ingredients.notes: Roast cumin seeds in a pan until fragrant

ingredients.name: Warmly roasted coriander
ingredients.notes: Roast coriander seeds in a pan until fragrant

ingredients.name: Ginger
ingredients.notes: Grate the ginger for use in the biryani

ingredients.name: Soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use low-sodium soy sauce for a healthier option

ingredients.name: Rice vinegar
ingredients.notes: Use Japanese rice vinegar for authentic flavor

instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium-high heat.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides.
Remove the lamb from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add the cumin and coriander seeds and roast until fragrant.
Add the grated ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the soy sauce, rice vinegar, water, salt, and black pepper to the pan.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the cooked lamb back to the pan and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until the lamb is tender.
Cook the sushi rice according to the package instructions.
Mix the cooked rice with the lamb and spice mixture in a large bowl.
Transfer the biryani to a serving dish and serve hot.
